text: {"findings":[{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"No generative AI / personal data review recorded","detail":"The proposal deploys a GenAI LLM chatbot that identifies customers by phone number (personal data) and reads order history. No privacy, legal, or AI governance review is recorded; only vendor selection is mentioned.","evidence_quote":"Deploy a GenAI chatbot using an LLM that identifies the customer by phone number and answers order status questions from order history.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record privacy/data protection and generative AI policy reviews (including vendor data handling and phone-number identification risks) before launch."},{"type":"UNDEFINED_METRIC","title":"Success metric 'Customer happiness' is not a canonical metric","detail":"'Customer happiness' is a vague name and not a defined glossary metric such as CSAT. It is unclear how it is measured or on what scale.","evidence_quote":"Customer happiness: from 4.0 to 4.4 within 12 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Replace with a canonical glossary metric (e.g., Support CSAT) with a clear definition and scale."},{"type":"UNSUPPORTED_CLAIM","title":"60% deflection expectation lacks source","detail":"The 60% contact deflection figure is stated without any source, pilot data, or benchmark.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Cite a source (vendor benchmark, pilot, historical analysis) or label it as an assumption to be tested."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days is not the issue, but plan is inconsistent and too short for the target","detail":"A 3-week experiment cannot validate a success metric targeted over 12 weeks. The MDE is expressed for contacts per 100 while the primary success metric is the satisfaction score, so power is not established for the stated success metric.","evidence_quote":"Duration: 3 weeks. MDE: 0.5 contacts per 100, power 80%.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align the experiment duration and MDE/power with the primary success metric, or align the success metric timeframe with the experiment."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Missing guardrails for AI answer quality and customer data","detail":"A customer-facing chatbot that answers from order data needs guardrails such as escalation/handoff to human, answer accuracy or hallucination rate, and privacy incidents. Only contact rate and delivery CSAT are listed.","evidence_quote":"Contact Rate: stop if it rises by more than 1 per 100.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as wrong-answer/hallucination rate, human escalation or repeat-contact rate, and privacy/misidentification incidents."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"Deflection target has no baseline or timeframe","detail":"The 60% deflection is the main goal but is not listed as a success metric with a baseline, definition, or timeframe. Guardrail thresholds also lack baselines.","evidence_quote":"We expect the chatbot to deflect 60% of contacts.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add a defined deflection/contact-rate success metric with a baseline, numeric target, and timeframe."}]}
